title: Executive Assistant
description:
Location: Hereford - fully office-based
Salary: £35,000-£40,000 p/a
Working Pattern: Full time, Monday Friday
Our client is a growing, close-knit business looking for an experienced Executive Assistant to provide high-level support to the Managing Director.
This is a broad and varied role within a small business, where you ll become a key point of support to the MD and play an important part in keeping the day-to-day operation organised and running smoothly.

What you ll do
- Provide comprehensive EA support to the Managing Director
- Manage a busy and complex diary, arranging meetings and appointments
- Coordinate travel arrangements, itineraries and accommodation
- Prepare meeting agendas, papers, presentations and correspondence
- Attend meetings, take notes and follow up on actions
- Manage emails and correspondence, prioritising key communications
- Coordinate internal and external meetings with clients, suppliers and stakeholders
- Handle confidential and commercially sensitive information with discretion
- Support the MD with projects, reporting and ad-hoc business activities
- Help keep the wider office organised and ensure actions are followed through

You ll work closely with the Managing Director and wider team, acting as a trusted and highly organised point of contact across the business.
What we re looking for
- Previous experience in an EA, PA or senior administrative support role
- Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail
- Confident managing a busy diary and competing priorities
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills
- Professional, discreet and comfortable handling confidential information
- Strong IT skills, including Microsoft Office
- A proactive approach, with the ability to work independently and use initiative

The ideal candidate will be organised, commercially aware and confident working directly with senior leadership. You ll enjoy being part of a smaller business where no two days are necessarily the same and where your contribution is genuinely valued.
Why join?
- £35,000 £40,000 salary
- Key support role working closely with the MD
- Varied position within an established small business
- Opportunity to have real visibility and impact
- Full-time, office-based role in Hereford

Apply now to take on a pivotal EA role within a growing and close-knit business.

title: Depot Administrator
company: Hough Green Garage Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Depot Administrator

Location: Hereford

Salary: £13.00 per hour

Vacancy Type: Permanent, Full time

Additional Requirement: Occasional Saturday mornings

Hough Green Garage is a market leader in the provision of 24-hour Breakdown and Recovery Services, with over 40 years of industry experience. We operate 365 days a year, supporting Local Authorities, Emergency Services, Motoring Organisations, private companies, and members of the public on a national basis.

Due to continued business growth and the award of new contracts, we are seeking an additional Depot Administrator to join our busy team at our Crewe depot. This is a varied and fast-paced role that plays a key part in the smooth day-to-day operation of our site.

The Role

As a Depot Administrator, you will be the first point of contact for customers and stakeholders, providing professional front-of-house support in a busy operational environment. This role requires strong organisational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to communicate confidently, including in challenging situations.

You will work both independently and as part of a small, supportive team to ensure the efficient running of depot operations.

Key Responsibilities
- Booking vehicles in and out of internal and external systems
- Ensuring correct charges are applied and paperwork matches system records
- Processing payments via online portals and over the counter
- Performing general administrative duties including data entry, filing, and task coordination
- Handling inbound and outbound telephone calls and accurately recording information
- Liaising with customers, emergency services, authorities, insurance companies, and colleagues
- Supporting the efficient day-to-day operation of the depot
- Communicating effectively with drivers and managers
- Ensuring all documentation is processed in accordance with company procedures and GDPR requirements
- Reconciling daily payments and financial records
- Following company policies, procedures, and relevant legislation

What We re Looking For

We are looking for a reliable and motivated individual who thrives in a busy environment and takes pride in delivering excellent customer service.

Skills and Experience
- Excellent telephone manner and communication skills
- Strong attention to detail and accuracy
- Ability to work under pressure and manage competing priorities
- Positive attitude and willingness to support team members
- Good organisational and problem-solving skills
- Strong customer service and interpersonal skills
- Commercial awareness and understanding of operational costs
- Computer literate with experience using Windows-based applications (full system training provided)
- Ability to work both independently and as part of a team
- Full, clean driving licence
- Ability to pass Police National Vetting (essential requirement)
- Stable, full-time employment in a well-established company
- Competitive hourly rate
- Overtime opportunities
- Supportive team environment
- Full training on company systems
- Opportunity to develop within a growing business

What We Offer

Stable, full-time employment in a well-established company

Competitive hourly rate

Overtime opportunities

Supportive team environment

Full training on company systems

Opportunity to develop within a growing business

To Apply

If you feel you are a suitable candidate and would like to work for Hough Green Garage, please do not hesitate to apply.

title: Medical Receptionist / Care Navigator
description: Full and Part time hours considered Interview date: 11th November 2026 Much Birch Surgery has an exciting opening for a Medical Receptionist / Care Navigator to join our team.We strive for excellent clinical and professional support, a healthy work-life balance and a challenging but rewarding career, whatever your area of interest. We pride ourselves on excellent patient care, fantastic teamwork and a willingness to look at new ways of working. Much Birch Surgery is a busy and forward-thinking GP practice serving the local area. We are committed to providing high-quality, patient-centred care and supporting our clinical and administrative teams to work effectively together. We have a broad range of clinical services and work closely with wider health and care partners to support our patients. We are continually looking at ways to improve our services, systems and ways of working, and this role offers an opportunity to become an important part of a supportive and collaborative practice team. Much Birch surgery: Is a busy rural dispensing practice at the heart of the community. Is located in the village of Much Birch, between Ross-on-Wye and Hereford city, covering a large area reaching from the edges of Hereford to Ross on Wye, and extending into the villages of the Golden Valley. Has a list size of circa 5,100+ patients Offers a supportive team of Receptionists/Care Navigators, Secretaries, Administrators, GPs, ANPs, Practice Nurses, HCAs, Physiotherapist, Social Prescribers. The role requires a high level of accuracy, organisation, confidentiality and attention to detail, together with the ability to manage competing priorities and work effectively as part of a busy practice team. These requirements are reflected throughout the JD, particularly around referrals, clinical systems, confidential information, communication and quality. Duties include: Deliver a professional and welcoming reception service for patients and visitors. Manage appointments, enquiries and patient registrations across face-to-face, telephone and online channels. Provide administrative support, including correspondence, records management and email monitoring. Maintain accurate, confidential patient records in line with policies and procedures. Support effective communication with patients, clinicians and external organisations. Contribute to a safe, organised and efficient practice environment and the smooth day-to-day running of the service. Job summary: Receive, assist and direct patients in accessing the appropriate service or healthcare professional in a courteous, efficient and effective way. Provide general assistance to the practice team and project a positive and friendly image to patients and other visitors, either in person or via the telephone. To be flexible to provide cover for colleagues absences in addition to normal working hours. To have a thorough knowledge of all practice procedures To work in accordance with written protocols Receiving patients, making appointments by telephone and in person and dealing with queries Taking and passing on messages to clinical and administration staff Registration of new patients Process patients change of address Processing and distributing incoming and outgoing mail Scanning, filing and coding of patient correspondence to medical records and forward to GPs as required Email / Fax and photocopy as requested Keeping the reception area, waiting room, notice-boards and leaflet dispensers tidy. Other: Pulling/filing notes for surgeries and update as necessary Clear, tidy and restock clinical rooms Ensure building security opening up/locking up of practice premises and maintaining security in accordance with Practice protocols Ensure compliance with strict confidentiality standards at all times Attend team meetings Attend training sessions Liaise with hospital and external agencies as required Any other tasks allocated by the Reception Manager and/or Practice Manager.
